Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Empower

A machine that turns atmospheric electricity to many useful ends.

Charm of Electromancy. After you spend a Long Rest in your Lightning Generator, you take 8d6 Lightning damage and gain a magical Charm for 7 days. It has 3 charges; you can expend 1 to cast Telekinesis, and it vanishes when all its charges are expended.

Revivification. When you cast Raise Dead or Resurrection in this facility, the cost of its Material components is reduced by 1,000 GP (minimum 0).

Empower: Lightning Life. The hireling channels the generator's energy to cast Animate Objects on one Large or Huge object of your choice in the Bastion; the spell lasts 7 days and doesn't require Concentration.

Source: Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.
